title: Open fills past target by queue
description: Synthetic db-query-portal saved script for the ENG-1799 demo: open fills per queue, and how many are older than the queue's target minutes.
sql:
SELECT q.name AS queue,
       q.target_minutes,
       count(*)::int AS open_fills,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.queued_at < now() - make_interval(mins => q.target_minutes))::int AS past_target
FROM fills f
JOIN queues q ON q.id = f.queue_id
WHERE f.completed_at IS NULL
GROUP BY q.name, q.target_minutes
ORDER BY q.name
